page: Amazon Web Services m6id.24xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. The baseline network bandwidth is 38 Gbps, and there are no GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with the stress-ng multi-core CPU test and Geekbench multi-core score placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 4972.07 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 138.88 GB/sec. Single-core performance, such as the stress-ng single-core test and Geekbench single-core score, falls in the middle 50% average tier.

The server exhibits strong capabilities in database operations, scoring in the top 25% for PassMark database operations and achieving 90.26 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. However, a notable tradeoff is observed in large language model (LLM) inference; while prompt processing for a large 70B model is average, text generation for the same model is weak, falling into the bottom 25% at 2.58 tokens/sec. This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded applications, database hosting, static web serving, and software compilation.
